newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tan Chong shares to requote Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: Tan Chong shares to requote Nov 28.

text.p: Share trading in Malaysian car assembler Tan Chong Motor Holdings Bhd, which announced a restructuring plan on Friday, will resume on November 28, the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) said.
The KLSE said the decision to lift the suspension followed a November 22 announcement by Tan Chong that it planned to float three of its divisions as separate companies.
Tan Chong said on Friday that it planned a restructuring which includes the spin-off of its autoparts, non-motor and foreign operations division to existing shareholders.
In a statement, it also said the motor division would be retained in Tan Chong.
The stock of Tan Chong, which assembles Nissan cars, was suspended on Friday pending a news announcement. Its stock closed at 4.76 ringgit on Thursday.

As part of the restructuring, Tan Chong said it would apply for the listing of the autoparts and non-motor divisions on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange and the foreign division on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong.
